notes.title: MERRY KRINGMAS with the CHEAT MODE GAMEPLAY!
notes.content:
Dearest Kringers!

[h1]Wishing you a very Merry KRINGMAS![/h1]

[h2]CHEAT MODE GAMEPLAY revealed![/h2]
For the occasion, I will reveal the way to unlock the CHEAT MODE GAMEPLAY and find Dev.Id, the black soul of the developer (that is, me)!

[i]Chorus:[/i] [b]YAY! YAY! GREAT!!![/b]

So, do the following:
[b]- TYPE ASTROPUPPA:[/b] in the start menu, type (with the keyboard) the name of the most absurdly expensive game on Steam, that is ASTROPUPPA
[b]- TYPE “D”:[/b] After you type ASTROPUPPA, you will be able to summon Dev.Id. Press “D” on the keyboard to do so.
[b]- UNLOCKED![/b] When Dev.Id appears, you will have unlocked the Cheat Mode Gameplay!
[b]- IN EVERY GAME TYPE “D”:[/b] you can call it in every game (except in the new version of Genesis and in BIODISSEA) to get information on the “local” cheat modes of the various games.
[b]- OTHER CHEAT MODES:[/b] after unlocking Dev.Id, still in the Start Menu, if you press “H” (and hold it down with your big finger) you will be shown a screen of additional Cheat Modes.

BIODYSSEY
Few, very few of you will have managed to access the [b]BIODYSSEY [/b]game, which is unlocked only by finishing all 27 levels of Genesis (new version)!
[b]BIODYSSEY [/b]is the 4X that I am doing (in parallel to everything else), in which with your population of Krings you have to colonize an asteroid lost in space.

By unlocking the [b]CHEAT MODE GAMEPLAY[/b], you can access it:
- in the [b]START MENU[/b], move the [b]pointer to the TOP RIGHT corner[/b] and [b]press “N”[/b] to start a new game of BIODISSEA.

Or, if you want the long way:
- From the Start Menu, click the icon at the bottom right, but right at the bottom bottom right (3 serpentoids)
- From there, click on the [b]STAR WHEEL[/b] or [b]ROTARY STAR[/b] at the bottom, quite far to the right
- You will arrive at a particular version of the [b]TURTLE ARK[/b]. Load as many Kring as you can and then go!

MERRY KRINGMAS!!!

notes.title: UPDATE FOR PARASITE FIGHTER!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Here we go again!!![/b][/h1]

So, I've been working hard the last few weekends and every moment I could dedicate to Parasite Fighter / Kring!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892703/4256d370c46f42d26de6f27d9894247bf1988ee2.png[/img]

Lots of new things! All for Parasite Fighter
1) I also added control via [b]Pad controller[/b]. So now you can play it with mouse, keyboard or game pad!
2) I developed [b]Progression [/b]well, which in practical terms means a sensible distribution of number of enemies, type and quantity of power-ups, and difficulty curve.
Let me know what you think, to better balance the game!
3) I inserted particular objects, the [b]DRONES[/b], which if touched by the spaceship activate and do things, positive for us and very bad for the enemies. There are 4 of them, you can find them in particular from the second level onwards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892703/6f9dc852fa8dfa3624faec96341fb0a40dfa4bea.png[/img]
4) I inserted the [b]TIME FOR CARNAGE[/b], so now there is a maximum time to eat all the parasites on the screen, which makes the matter much more "challenging".
It still needs to be calibrated well, but it already forces you to get busy biting and biting as much as you can!
5) I added [b]artificial intelligence[/b] (big word!) to the enemies, which therefore now move in a much more varied way than before, from wave to wave.
6) I added [b]animations for the enemies[/b], which now move with greater variety.

Furthermore, I had included multilingual support, which also worked, but due to a (apparently known) Game Maker problem in displaying particular characters (for German and Spanish), I had to remove it.
If I understand how to solve it (for now without success) I will re-implement it, otherwise the game will remain only ITA-ENG.

[b]Next discount for Kring expected just after Christmas.[/b]

CIAOOOOOOOOO

notes.title: ENJOY THE CARNAGE
notes.content:
Here we go again!
I finally managed to complete the [b]CARNAGE [/b]version, that is, the phase of the game in which with our spaceship [i]we can SLAUGH enemies[/i], peeling off pieces of their alien flesh, stripping their skeleton bare, devouring and destroying them!
[previewyoutube=JdZtnbLLTPM;full][/previewyoutube]

In this video, if you have the will to go all the way through, you will also see the first of the boss-battles with the [b]PARASITE MOTHER[/b]!
- - - 
[u]Also, other new features:[/u]
- [b]system to keep some of the powerups[/b] obtained even after you die (and trust me, you will die!). You will see fangs on either side of the powerups in the lower left corner. Click on them to choose the powerups to 'lock,' that is, the ones you will find active again once you die and re-spawn. But beware, you can only 'block' two of them, so you must choose which ones. Give priority to speed and maneuverability? Or to armament? Or to the shield?
To select which powerup to keep, you can also press [b]F1-F2-F3-F4-F5[/b].
 
- fadein effect with fangs between game cover and actual game.

- during CARNAGE, enemies if you get too close to them (which you have to do, if you want to maul them) run away!

Finally, I've added something a little strange, which is a [u]warning[/u] in the OPTIONS and Kring's MAIN MENU warning of the [b]great dangers of activating the old version of GENESIS[/b].
Because, yes, there is still somewhere a bug-crash that manifests itself in inexplicable ways that I really can't pinpoint in the little time I can devote to it.
So, if you play the old version of GENESIS, [b]be aware of this[/b]!

[b][i]HAVE FUN![/i][/b]

notes.title: Old version of the Genesis game now restored
notes.content:
[h2]I reactivated the old version of Genesis! Which those who saw the birth of Kring know.... [/h2]
[previewyoutube=OJNQ96ZCWkM;full][/previewyoutube]

Since it's really weird and cryptic, I decided a while back to remake it from scratch by making the gameplay a little more intelligible and flowing by putting an option that allowed the old version to be reactivated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892703/ade816da8111594d9103b9fa2bdf04ccf9cd714d.png[/img]

Then, in the weeks before the release, seeing that crashes generated by the old code from the old version of Genesis would pop up from time to time, I disabled it and made it inaccessible in order to prevent the game from crashing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892703/c970e2b16af61683a4b2cf478136400b41f3060e.png[/img]
Now I've caught the bug that generated the crash -- I hope no more mysterious ones pop up! The code in the old version of Genesis is really old and rather fragile... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892703/1b5b41591159168cefe0d5b882c035c14bc18279.png[/img]
Go into the OPTIONS and turn on the second-to-last option “GENESIS VERSION” to “ORIGINAL and CRYPTIC”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892703/71e60ea0b3ac4642793f0f4222185ab58a20c97e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892703/e55ee1ecdcc88634276d1bbcdc3fdb2ac38d1079.png[/img]

Also:
[b]- PARASITE FIGHTER:[/b] I inserted PAUSE!!! Press the “P” key to pause the game. It looks like a small thing but it's not :) basically I had to put my hands in all the items in the game!
But now it's done and it will also come in handy for future developments of the game.
- I also added new firing types and animations of the spaceship when it fires. If you want the cheat to change the firing type, press F5 during the game.

[b]- BIODISSEY:[/b] Now, when you enter Biodissey you will find available all the resources you have collected in New Genesis.
Now, accessing Biodissey (which is the 4X section of Kring - yet another game within a game!) is not a simple matter: first you have to finish all of New Genesis, collecting as many resources as you can; then go to the Leaderboard (on the icon of which will be Biodissey), you will see all the resources you have collected, and click the Rotating Star; so you go to the Tartar screen, which will look different than usual. Load up your Kring army and set off. There you will arrive in the Biodissey, with all the resources (that you have previously collected in New Genesis) available!

[i][u]Note[/u]: Biodissey is still LOTS of work-in-progress. As soon as I finish Parasite Fighter (in which I now have to implement the artificial intelligences of the various enemies and create a decent increasing difficulty progression) I'll get back into it and finish it. I can't wait to get back into healthy data game design![/i]

I hope that some of you guys will play this new Kring version and tell me what you think!
Have a great week!

Ivan Venturi

notes.title: PARASITE FIGHTER - alpha version
notes.content:
And here is the alpha version of the new minigame (which you can play by clicking NOVELTY GAME in the main menu): [b]PARASITE FIGHTER[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892703/fd8648602ae5a5a9668469554bc878ca2e0b6275.png[/img]

You can use mouse or keyboard (WASD or ARROWS and space/control/enter keys). Best with mouse.
[b][u]Left key[/u]: shoot.[/b] There is no limit of shots, so go ahead and shoot tons of bullets.
[b][u]Right key[/u]: boost[/b] temporary. If you want to go fast, click a lot!

For now there are:
- [b]10 waves[/b], each with a different enemy. The artificial intelligence of the various enemies is still super-silent, but it already gives flavor to exterminate them!
- [b]3 game stages[/b]: NATURAL, MICRO, SUPERHOT, to which is added the PARASITE MOTHER final boss stage at the end of each level. There are 5 different Parasite Mother for now (in the end of 5 different levels).
- [b]Endless levels[/b] of increasing difficulty. Linear progression, minimal difficulty balance.

[previewyoutube=UyoG8al1Bx4;full][/previewyoutube]

Collect the various power-ups (temporary graphics) found for:
- SPEED
- SHIELD.
- SHOOTING TYPE.
- MANEUVERABILITY.


Let me know what you think!

I'm leaving for Gamescom now, but as soon as I can I'll do:
[list]
[*] player's starship graphics
[*] power-up graphics
[*] special actions and attacks for each type of enemy
[*] enemy AIs
[*] a nicely designed title
[*] a nice opening screen to let you know where you are fighting (you are inside an alien plant, reduced to microscopic size, and you have to eliminate all the parasites to save said plant)
[*] audio SFX
[/list]

Saludos!

notes.title: WORKING ON A NEW MINIGAME!
notes.content:
Ciao everybody!
Just to let you know I'm working on a new minigame (not so mini) called [b]PARASITE FIGHTER[/b].
You'll find it soon in the [u]KRING - IT'S HARD TO BE A GOD update[/u]!
The game is nearly completed, but wow I'm going to Gamescom so I'll publish the update after that, about end of august.

The game has sold less than 60 copies so far, so you might ask... but why do you keep working on it?
Because it's my fun! I already make video games as a professional. But making video games as a professional means thinking about the market, the money, the practical aspects. Which wouldn't allow me, an old game developer, to write code (I basically program empirically! My basics go back to the assembler 6510 of the Commodore 64!)
And instead I really enjoy both programming (non-nerds cannot understand how good it is) and doing graphics and game-design.
So here I am, continuing the KRING development!

Here some hand-drawn asset:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892703/8f91ccc9f687117bd21589206f1a96fec974402c.png[/img]

Ciao!
Ivan

notes.title: OUT NOW!!! KRING IS AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
This is it!
[b]KRING is finally on sale![/b]

I started making it for pure fun exactly 6 years ago, from a gameplay idea of male and female cells moving through a game space, mating and procreating, and drawing on a virtual canvas their movements, thus photographing the genesis of the people themselves.

Then, again just for fun, I kept adding races, creatures, weapons, levels. And then subgames, other games, a story, animations--always driven by what I felt like doing when I felt like doing it.
[i]Oh, and I drew it all by hand![/i]

Because of this, KRING is an absolutely anomalous game. Many things you will have to try more than once before you understand how they work. 
[i]The instructions however are there, for those who will be willing to read them :)[/i]

[b]At the time of launch, KRING has 546 wishlists, which is very few[/b]. So predictably, sales will be just as few (if, on the other hand, you who are reading this decide to buy the game... well, THANK YOU!).

[b]But little matter! [/b]
[i](I will admit, however, that I will consume the F5 button to see the sales in real time)[/i].
Fun it was and fun it remains!

[b]I'm already working on the next two mini-games[/b] that I'll put inside Kring after the release.
And I won't stop. Why?
[u]Because making video games is the greatest thing in the world, and making Kring is for me the greatest way to make video games![/u]

Thank you for reading everything! 
(And many more thanks if you play KRING)

[b]AD MAJORA![/b]
[i]Ivan Venturi[/i]

notes.title: Kring: what are they?
notes.content:
Colours and stupidity: that’s what KRING are made of, aliens who really look like to[strike] the elderly[/strike], [strike]the aged[/strike], the senior videogames developer.

In KRING you take the mantle of a “loser” God and you have to take care of the Kring breeds, the dumbest creatures in the Universe.

Raise, feed and protect your alien minions to unlock new KRING breeds. 

Let them thrive and cross the most dangerous corners of the galaxy, and who knows maybe you will even get revenge on the snarky Cool Gods.

Follow Kring and add to your wishlist!
